description: List this account's machines by name: serial number, the operation type each performs, whether an operation is running on it now (and on which work order), and how many unfinished operations are assigned to it. Filter by inUse or by text in the name, serial number or description. Up to 100 per page. Operator credentials only.

inUse.description: true for machines running an operation now, false for free ones.

search.description: Text to find in the name, serial number or description.

name: list_machines
title: List Machines
